note: Ghent: the late-medieval enceinte of c. 1300 (about 13 km round 644 ha), modernised with bastions and outworks from the 16th c.; ring from the georeferenced trace on nl.wikipedia 'Gentse stadspoorten' (after 'De poorten en wallen van Gent'), checked against Ferraris (1777). The Spanjaardenkasteel (Charles V's citadel of 1540-45 on the site of the Sint-Baafsabdij) is traced from Ferraris as a fort. Most of the wall line is water (Leie, Schelde, Lieve, moats).
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Gent' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140021)
